snapshot.scope: Workbench, five private component repositories, and private Integration after the return to a multi-repository layout.
snapshot.method: Read-only GitHub REST API snapshot of default branches, registered Actions workflows, their source files where present, and recent workflow runs/jobs. Public Workbench CI history is sampled by its CI workflow; component repositories use their recent repository run list filtered to the primary qualification workflow. At most 20 runs are retained for each repository.

timing_definitions.workflow_elapsed_seconds: run updated_at minus created_at; includes queue time
timing_definitions.job_seconds_sum: sum of started_at to completed_at across observed jobs; parallel jobs overlap and this is not wall time

limitations: A GitHub Actions workflow record can outlive its source file; such entries are marked source_missing_at_snapshot.
No Actions secrets, logs, branch names, actor identities, tokens, or runner names were saved.
The organization runner inventory endpoint returned HTTP 403 without admin:org permission; runner registration on VPS hosts is therefore unverified.
Private repositories are inspected through authorized GitHub access; their code and raw logs are not copied into this report.
A skipped workflow is not a successful qualification.
The GitHub billing page supplied by the owner showed the private Actions included quota exhausted and overage blocked; billing state is not queried through this snapshot.
Exact internal labels of private self-hosted runners are omitted from this public evidence copy.

workflow_inventory.name: Apply refactor issues from audit PR

definitions.quick_feedback: run creation to last completed quick lane
definitions.job_queue_and_matrix_wait: job created_at to first executed step; includes queue, matrix throttling and runner provisioning
definitions.p95: nearest rank; always report sample count
